title: Introducing Trusted Access for Cyber
summary: OpenAI introduces Trusted Access for Cyber, a trust-based framework that expands access to frontier cyber capabilities while strengthening safeguards against misuse.
body: OpenAI introduces Trusted Access for Cyber, a trust-based framework that expands access to frontier cyber capabilities while strengthening safeguards against misuse.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了面向网络安全领域的信任访问框架Trusted Access for Cyber。该框架旨在扩展授权用户对前沿网络安全人工智能能力的访问权限，同时建立更加严格的安全防护与滥用防范机制，平衡技术开放与安全合规。
